description: This file declares the UserDao interface, which provides data access methods for User entities, including finding, saving, and removing users.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access operations for User objects in the system

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User by their userId

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Persists a User object to the database

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a User identified by userId from the database
